requirements.rule: Art. 51 ter: the premio di campagna of the conserve vegetali.
Art. 73: the EDR enters the TFR base only from 1 March 2024; the file counts it for every period.
Art. 21 B-C: the pay of the first-level and alta formazione apprentices.

HEALTH AND BILATERAL FUNDS: the employer contributions to FASA (EUR 16 a month), the Cassa maternità, the bilateralità and the Cassa rischio vita (Art. 74 ter-quinquies) are owed for every worker; a firm outside the bilateral funds owes instead the EDR of EUR 20 x 12 of Art. 74 bis. Neither is modelled: the employer cost, and with the EDR the net pay, are short of them.
Art. 31: the premiums on ordinary night, shift night, holiday and Sunday work.

OVERTIME (Art. 31): the engine holds the first table (Carni, Dolciari, Alimenti zootecnici, Lattiero-caseari: 45% day, 50% night, 60% holiday). The other sub-sector tables (vini-liquori, bevande, acque minerali, distillatori, birra, conserve vegetali, alimentari varie, risiera, molitoria e pastificazione, conserve ittiche, avicoli, involucri) set other night and holiday rates, and most of them a higher column for intermedi and impiegati (up to 70% night, 90% holiday). The base of Art. 31 excludes the IAR and the EDR: the caller states OvertimeEvent.hourly_rate.

The run reads an INPS ruleset marked provisional: the INPS circulars of its year are not published yet, so the rates, the massimale and the minimale (and the hourly contributions of domestic work) are those of the year before, carried over. The indexed amounts change every January: the carried-over values understate them.

The run reads a tax ruleset marked provisional: the sources of its year are not published yet (budget law of the year; regional and municipal surtax resolutions), so the values are those of the year before, carried over. Rules in force by statute (the IRPEF brackets of art. 11 and the deductions of art. 13 of the testo unico of D.Lgs. 117/2026) carry over unchanged; any change of the budget law is not applied.

Art. 51 bis: the trattamento economico per mancata contrattazione di secondo livello, EUR 21.90 at level 6 to 50.37 at 1S a month for 12 months from 1 January 2023, 32.85 to 75.55 from 1 January 2027, outside the TFR, owed by firms without a premio per obiettivi.

The CCNL tier and the comporto are counted on the days of one episode and the relapses it continues. A CCNL that sums the sickness of separate episodes over a window (a calendar year, the last three years) can reach a lower tier or the end of the comporto earlier than the engine shows. The run is affected when an earlier episode outside the relapse chain is recorded.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.sickness.day.rules (CCNL tier of a sick day)

requirements.rule: SICKNESS (Art. 47): modelled as 100% of the net normal pay for 186 calendar days per episode. Not modelled: over 5 years of seniority the next 179 days at 50%; the comporto of 186 days within 17 months (up to 5 years) and 365 days within 24 months (over 5), summed over different illnesses; the 90 more days for disabled workers; the fixed-term limit (4 months, integration no longer than the INPS indemnity); the apprentice's normal pay for at most six months a year (Art. 21). The net pay is computed by grossing up the INPS indemnity by the worker's INPS rate, as for the Commercio file.

The INPS share of a sick day is the INPS rate times the CCNL daily quota of the current month, counted on the CCNL payable days. INPS computes it on its own daily base (retribuzione media globale giornaliera of the month before) and on calendar days. The worker's total for the day is the same; the split between INPS indemnity (outside the contribution base) and employer integration may differ, and with it the contributions.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.sickness.handlers (INPS share of a sick day)

requirements.rule: An apprentice whose TFR goes to a pension fund or to the Fondo Tesoreria takes the 0.28-point relief of D.L. 203/2005 art. 8, but not the exemption from the 0.20% Fondo di garanzia contribution of D.Lgs. 252/2005 art. 10 c. 2: no source found says whether the apprentice rate (10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus NASpI and the integration funds) holds a Fondo di garanzia share to exempt. The employer contributions of the run may be overstated by 0.20% of the INPS base.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.severance.relief.services; INPS messaggio n. 5859 of 7 March 2008, par. 3 (art. 8 relief of apprentices); INPS circ. 70/2007 par. 6 (Fondo di garanzia exemption, rates 0.20% and 0.40%)
